musicnn-voice-dense-v1.model: MusiCNN voice/instrumental (essentia.js), p(voice) per mel patch

htdemucs-vocal-db-v1.model: htdemucs (Demucs v4) vocal stem, whole song
htdemucs-vocal-db-v1.unit: dBFS, loudest 0.1s RMS in each patch

htdemucs-whisper-turbo-words-v1.model: Whisper on the htdemucs vocal stem, whole song
htdemucs-whisper-turbo-words-v1.unit: highest probability of a word Whisper large-v3-turbo (faster-whisper, int8) recognised in the stem, over the patch

mix-db-v1.unit: dBFS, loudest 0.1s RMS in each patch

melband-kim-vocal-db-v1.model: Mel-Band RoFormer vocals (Kimberley Jensen, audio-separator) on candidate windows only; 255 = not measured
melband-kim-vocal-db-v1.unit: dBFS, loudest 0.1s RMS in each patch

melband-kim-whisper-turbo-words-v1.model: Whisper on the Mel-Band RoFormer vocal stem of the same candidate windows
melband-kim-whisper-turbo-words-v1.unit: highest probability of a word Whisper large-v3-turbo (faster-whisper, int8) recognised in the stem, over the patch
